extraction.notes: Sample extraction under rules 0.5. Covered: executive summary (page 9, service delivery paragraph) and the whole Service delivery area (pages 96-109: summary and recommendations, Principles 1 to 4). Keyword screen of the whole text: digital, digitalis, e-service, electronic, interoperab, MConnect, MSign, MPass, MPay, e-signature, eID, e-ID, identity card, register, data protection, personal data, cyber, artificial, foreign, migra, work permit, MTender. No material on foreign workers or Chapter 2 found ("foreign" hits are the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and foreign-currency debt). No artificial intelligence, personal data protection or cybersecurity claims found (ITCSS appears only as an agency name). Not covered in this sample and left for full extraction: the e-procurement portal MTender (executive summary page 9, PFM summary page 112, public procurement analysis pages 138-145), which meets the TECH-DGOV test as a portal used by bidders; HRMIS and the employee salary register (pages 55, 59) and the e-integrity system (page 79), which are back-office systems and probably out under the materiality test. Service delivery items on administrative simplification, quality management, the Administrative Code and accessibility for people with disabilities were not extracted (no digital subject). Website accessibility items are flagged theme_doubtful. Page numbers are the converted-text page markers (printed page = marker minus one).
